sheets.name: Sheet1
sheets.data_rows: 4-611 (block 1 rows 4-545; second header at 546; block 2 rows 547-611)
sheets.grain: One seed lot (tag) per sowing, with its collection, stratification, sowing and first pricking-out. Continuation rows (no tag, no species, merged cells in A-G) record further pricking-out batches for the same lot (e.g. row 7 under S3). Row 546 is a repeated header: from there tags restart at S1 for 2022 collections sown from 24 Aug 2022.

columns.notes: Lot tag. Four formats: S1-S~220 (2016-17), five-digit S218xx, six-digit YYMMNN (e.g. S2101xx), then a restart at S1 in the second block (row 546 onwards). Also 'S 99', trailing spaces and 'a' suffixes. 66 tags appear twice (restart). Blank on continuation rows.
Mixed Latin binomials (often truncated), common names, genus only, and notes ('ON HOLD,', 'surplus', 'Mtn Beech seedlings'). 173 raw distinct, 170 after trim and lower-casing.
SENSITIVE: seed-source place per lot. Values withheld. Mixture of full names and short codes (a legend of codes exists in the 2016-17 file and the 2017 .doc).
501 date cells, 28 text (month names, approximate or malformed dates, '?/2/22'). Two impossible years.
Treatment text (duration or method) but 5 cells hold dates (E4:E23 area) in the 2016 rows. Many spellings of the same thing.
Seed quantity with inconsistent units (volume spoons, cups, grams, approximate '~'). 25 bare integers.
Date sown (Stage 1 germination tray). 3 text cells. 33 rows dated 2022-10-10, after the file was last saved (28 Aug 2022).
Date pricked out. 17 text cells, some holding several dates in one cell ('22/08/2018 21/11/2018 27/3/2019'). Further pricking batches on continuation rows.
Count pricked out (seedlings). 308 numeric, 35 text ('discarded' x15, '?' x2, '35F' misplaced pot size, '3 + 6', '12      6'). 41 zeros.
Container. V150 (170 rows) and T28 are WRT containers; '35F', '7', '5', '90', '1L', '6 cell tray' are other pot or tray sizes. Many variants ('T28 ', 'T 28', 'v150', 'V150/PB3', '5&7').

Germination date, tray fraction, discard date, surplus given away. Some notes name places or landowners (e.g. at K47); treat column as potentially sensitive. 124 notes mention germ, 80 discard, 90 tray.

quality_issues.issue: Second header row embedded mid-sheet with differently worded headers ('Date collected', 'amount', 'Date pricked n', ' #'); tags restart at S1 so Tag No. is not unique.

open_questions_for_wrt: Which copy is the live seed log? '_Seed records-Helen-[name].xlsx' (927 rows, to Dec 2025) is larger than the _MASTER copy (848 rows, to Feb 2025). Which one holds the true record?
Why do tags restart at S1 from row 546 (2022 sowings)? Is the tag system now 'S' plus a running number per year, and are old and new S numbers ever meant to be unique together?
What do the tag formats mean: S1-S220, S21801, S210108, S220705? Is S2101xx year, month and sequence?
What does red font on Tag and Species cells mean (about 330 rows)?
What do pot sizes '35F', '7', '5' and '90' stand for, and how do they map to V150, T28 and PB3?
Is a blank 'Date pricked' with '#' = 0 or 'discarded' a loss, a failed sowing, or not yet pricked out?
Should 'seedlings' in the Collected or Stratified column be treated as bought-in or wild-lifted plants rather than seed lots?
Are the sowing dates of 10 Oct 2022 in the August 2022 file planned dates?
Can the 2016-17 day/month swap be confirmed (e.g. S2 collected 1 May 2016, not 5 Jan 2016)?
Can the archive versions (May 2022, Nov 2023, Oct 2023, Dec 2024, 'Seed records 2017.doc', 'WRT 2016-17 seed.xlsx') be treated as superseded once the latest log is imported?
